notes.title: 🥩 So, what the heck is Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine?!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807843/c41c782ee648062ecea9a3554e5da7bf35954d45.jpg

Greetings, Meat Boy lovers and puzzlers!

It's so good to meat you! (Dang, what a bad one... So sorry, but I couldn't help myself! 😅)

But in our defence, I have to say that it's really a state of emergency here right now. In a figurative sense, I mean! Because tomorrow (finally!!!), Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine will see the light of your hard drives, and that's why we might be a teensy bit excited. But really only a very little bit...

That's why we can't give you a longer text update post today. And that's why we'd like to use today's update to tell you openly and honestly what you can expect from Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine.

So, let's go! Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine in a nutshell:

 Genre: action puzzle game
 Number of worlds: 6 overall
 Number of levels: 120 (20 levels in each world)
 Number of clones: 16
 Number of evolutionary stages of the clones: 4
 Number of bosses: 6 (1 boss in each world, you might know them from the Meat Boy games...)
 Average estimated playtime for a single playthrough: approx. 6-9 hours
 Average estimated playtime for all levels rated A+: approx. 1 1/2 hours (in the case you never die!)
 Number of tantrums per playthrough: Only our neighbours know that...
 Number of devs who worked on the game: 2 (complete staff: 21)
 Development time: 14 months (plus 2 months of prototyping)
And that's it. No more, but also no less. And believe me, we are really looking forward to sharing our "meaty baby" with you tomorrow! ❤️

Happy Meat Grinding Wednesday to all of you!
Mark & the Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228030/Dr_Fetus_Mean_Meat_Machine/

notes.title: 🥩 Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Demo got updated! 🔥
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807843/63a123d611c12409459b45b80f102b568df43c4a.jpg

Hey friends!

We are really blown away by the number of you folks that played our Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine demo! As well as by the massive amount of feedback - thank you so much for that! ❤️

You also brought up a number of issues in the demo, and we are working on fixing those at the moment. We recently updated the demo build, and that's the fixes/additions/improvements that come with the update:

 Fixed endless chains bug
 Added 180° rotation when stuck between two columns
 Better distinguishable preview icons
 Chains now resolve after finishing a level
 Updated missile FX
 Updated breakaway tiles FX
 Additional minor fixes and tweaks
Thanks for pointing those out! And if you liked the demo, please follow and wishlist the game, this would really help us a lot! ːsteamhappyː

Till then and have a great week everyone!
Mark & the Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339790

Greetings again Meat Boy friends and puzzlers!

And welcome to the very first ever "Super Meat Boy Franchise Sale" here on Steam - featuring the freshly announced Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine! ːsteamhappyː

And that's what you can expect from our little franchise sale:

 The first ever chance to get your fingers on Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine with the just released demo!
 High discounts for Super Meat Boy and Super Meat Boy Forever - including the corresponding DLCs of course!
 Some good old Super Meat Boy vibes
 Our eternal and endless gratitude for visiting the franchise sale page!
 Julian and Tim competing against each other in playing the Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine demo in the broadcast - under the wary eyes of dev Mark (great fun!)
And that's it. We hope you all have a good time with our beloved Meat Boy and his nemesis Dr. Fetus!

See you all in the broadcast, friends!
Tommy, Team Meat & the Dr. Fetus Team
